entries.design: Tall lean long-distance courier with a narrow swept forehead crest, four long slim mandibles, short dreadlocks gathered into a high single knot. A triangulated cross-chest travel harness, a flat hard-shell satchel with a broad beveled flap at the left hip, single padded shoulder guard and short split civic wrap. Right hand hooks the chest strap while the left holds a small unmarked sealed dispatch capsule. Ochre mottled hide, relaxed offset stance.

Short, broad and compact courier with a wide domed cranium, heavy blunt mandibles and chunky shoulder-length dreadlocks. A rigid low backpack frame carrying three sealed dispatch cylinders, broad load-bearing belly belt, short sleeveless woven work tunic and one square kneepad. Both hands adjust the waist buckle; feet set apart. Rust-tan scale pattern. Clearly new anatomy, outfit and silhouette.

Very long-legged agile courier with a ridged elongated forehead, outward-curving upper mandibles and a single thick bundle of long dreadlocks draped forward over one shoulder. Asymmetric small travel half-cape leaving arms clear, a crescent-shaped ceramic dispatch case worn across the back and narrow crossed hip belts. Left forearm raised to examine a simple wrist route device, right hand rests on the case strap. Muted olive hide.

Mature muscular city courier with a square skull, heavy angular four mandibles, a notch in one upper facial ridge and dreadlocks tied in two low back loops. Reinforced rectangular dispatch chest with a handle supported under the left forearm, diagonal broad shoulder strap, quilted sleeveless civic jerkin and calf wraps. Right hand gives a modest open-handed greeting. Deep russet mottled scales.

Slender adult female Yautja courier with a narrow rounded skull, delicate but unmistakable four toothed mandibles, swept side dreadlocks tied low, and long limbs. Practical high-waisted double-sash travel tunic, tiny shoulder mantle, offset leather map satchel with three overlapping flaps, no sexualized clothing. Slight forward lean inspecting an unmarked courier token between two fingers; other hand secures satchel. Sand-grey scales.

Exceptionally tall heavily built courier with a flattened broad cranium, short tusked mandibles and thick layered dreadlocks reaching shoulder blades. Twin trapezoid side pouches, a horizontal roll secured high on back, broad harness with circular bronze chest clasp, short protective skirt tabs. Both hands rest on the upper harness straps, broad stable idle stance. Charcoal-grey scales with pale mottling.

Short wiry mountain-route courier with an angular bony face, narrow four mandibles, dreadlocks assembled into a tall compact topknot and a few short side locks. Rope coils on one hip, long sealed cylindrical dispatch container diagonally across the back, light climbing harness, triangular woven waist wrap and forearm wraps. Busy tying a small cord knot at waist with both hands. Muted brown-olive skin.

Tall slim elderly adult courier with a low brow ridge, prominent downturned outer mandibles, weathered pale-grey mottled hide and shorter sparse dreadlocks with small plain brass beads. Rigid laminated folio case hanging vertically at the chest, layered asymmetrical sleeveless vest, slim hip pouch and plain cloth leg wraps. Head inclined to the right and one hand extended in a restrained explanatory gesture.

Stocky broad-necked courier with a low wide skull, thick squared mandibles and heavy slicked-back dreadlocks fastened at one side. Circular ribbed courier canister suspended at the right hip on a broad shoulder yoke, short scalloped shawl, sturdy belt with one triangular pouch. Right hand touches canister latch, left palm open at waist; weight on rear leg. Dark ochre scales with irregular pale spots.

Athletic medium-height courier with a tall central cranial ridge, long curved lower mandibles and a fan-shaped array of dreadlocks tied together midway down. Ribbed oval messenger backpack, narrow chest harness with offset buckles, looped utility belt and split kneelength travel tabard. One arm points a small blank direction baton down-right while the other grips the backpack strap. Umber-grey hide.

Lean barrel-chested courier with a broad cheek ridge and short asymmetrical mandible tusks, most dreadlocks gathered into a lateral braid behind the left shoulder. Hinged flat octagonal dispatch case carried by its top handle at the right thigh, wraparound single-shoulder harness, layered short travel kilt and two tiny belt rolls. Standing with one knee softly bent and the left hand checking a buckle. Moss-grey scales.

Broad-hipped powerful adult female Yautja courier with a wide crown, robust four mandibles and thick loose dreadlocks tied with bands at different lengths. Woven load vest with rectangular shoulder pads, paired cylindrical courier tubes on chest straps, practical split skirt with strong leg wraps. Cradles one sealed narrow cylinder across both palms as if checking a delivery. Dull copper mottled skin, dignified upright stance.

Tall narrow-waisted courier with a swept high cranium, flared outer mandibles and very short dreadlocks forming a ring around the rear crown. Low back rectangular dispatch pack with two stiff upward handles, crossed linen-and-leather harness, padded forearms and long asymmetrical front waist panel. Torso slightly turned right, both hands hold a small closed courier pouch forward. Pale olive-grey hide.

Compact older muscular courier with a heavy sloped brow, close-set four mandibles and a thick dreadlock beard-like side curtain that stops at the shoulders. Broad oval leather satchel hanging at front left, high sturdy collar, one small shoulder plate and layered rectangular skirt tabs. Right hand pulls a courier seal strap taut while left steadies satchel. Granite-grey spotted skin, bowed but confident head.

Long-limbed female adult courier with a small arched cranial crest, slender angular mandibles and dreadlocks woven into a high horizontal loop at the back. Twin thin hard dispatch folios crossing at the back, minimal crossed travel straps over a plain sleeveless tunic, narrow wrapped sash and one leg pouch. Left hand lifted to wrist communicator, right relaxed with slightly spread clawed fingers. Burnished amber hide.

Very broad tall courier with a deeply furrowed squared skull, outward flaring four mandibles and long thick dreadlocks gathered in a low thick ponytail. Large trapezoid travel backpack with one strapped woven roll, heavy curved chest yoke, wide double belt and short divided utility apron. One hand braces a shoulder strap, the other carries a small rectangular sealed parcel by a handle. Dark olive mottled skin.

Medium-height agile courier with a narrow triangular forehead, long pointed lower mandibles and dreadlocks divided into two low symmetric bunches. Elongated teardrop satchel at right hip, wraparound upper torso webbing, one short triangular cloak flap and elastic-looking woven leg wraps. Paused mid-step while checking a small flat unmarked route plaque in the left hand. Warm grey speckled hide.

Short round-shouldered adult courier with a bulbous domed crown, thick curved four mandibles and very dense chin-length dreadlocks. Front-worn boxy layered dispatch bag with two protruding cylindrical sockets, short padded open-side tunic and wide hip support straps. Both hands carefully place a sealed small tube into an existing socket, feet firmly planted. Golden-brown spotted skin.

Lean veteran courier with a long ridged skull, widely separated angular upper mandibles, intact four mandibles and grey-tipped long dreadlocks tied into a narrow back braid. Angular triangular metal dispatch case across one shoulder, travel harness with two different-width straps, knee wrap on one leg, high-cut short civic tunic. Right arm folded lightly across torso, left hand resting on the rigid case handle. Weathered slate skin.

Tall balanced build adult female courier with a broad smooth forehead plate, sturdy four mandibles and layered dreadlocks swept back into a low loose arc. Curved two-part messenger satchel with a central locking plate and attached short document tube, sleeveless overlapping travel vest, braided utility belt and split paneled lower wrap. Three-quarter right-facing idle, left hand offers a small sealed neutral package while right steadies hip strap. Warm muted sand scales.

visualNotes: 20 independent full-body adult Yautja couriers; each original PNG inspected. Unique clothing, carried gear, poses and head/dreadlock details. Courier03 has tight hair margin but no clipping. All original PNG bytes preserved.
